I found no bugs in the uncommitted changes. They touch `text/slug.py`; `tests/` is untracked and I didn't read it.

- **`slugify`:** the diff only adds a docstring, so behavior is unchanged.
- **`unique_slug`:** it returns the base slug if it's free. Otherwise it tries `-2`, `-3` and so on until one isn't in `taken`. It terminates because `taken` is finite. It doesn't mutate `taken`, so the caller has to add the result to `taken` itself.

One edge case that is not a bug: a title that slugifies to `"untitled"` is handled the same way, so you get `untitled`, `untitled-2` and so on.
